the following questions: How did Mexico’s political regime affect the negotiation and implementation of NAFTA? What are the implications of NAFTA for the economic development of Mexico? How has the Mexican economy performed since NAFTA? What are its main achievements and challenges?

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the impact of NAFTA on growth and development is still unclear.
NAFTA had some positive effects on growth and development, and some negative ones, but that its final impact was limited.
the NAFTA commitment device was a good idea that was poorly implemented.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in Mexico, NAFTA’s impact on growth and development was positive and significant but not enough to transform the country into a middle-income economy.
the NAFTA commitment device has had positive results in the areas of growth and trade, but the evidence on its development impact is mixed.

, despite the many challenges, the Mexican government was able to negotiate an agreement that was consistent with the country’s political and economic realities, and that it was able to implement it in a way that was consistent with its own priorities and interests.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Mexican government’s ability to negotiate and implement NAFTA depended on the political regime in place at the time.
Mexico’s authoritarian political regime was the most important constraint to the implementation of a pro-growth and pro-development NAFTA.
the NAFTA experience is not a simple tale of economic liberalization and its impact on development.
